title: MV Need help with Victor Engine Battle Status Menu

posts.author: Tamarin
posts.body:
I want to make a single actor game in RPG Maker, and I used Victor Engine's Battle Status Window plugin to make a custom window.  However, I've come across two issues that I don't know how to fix.
1:  The highlight that appears over a specified actor in the default battle status window while selecting an action still appears in my custom window.
2:  Incompatibility with plugins for skipping actor selection in battle.  Since I am making a single actor game I want to skip actor selection when choosing an item or skill that targets allies.  I tried both Magnus0808's Single Actor System and Galv's Single Actor Menu Target, but neither of them work with Victor Engine's Battle Status Window; an error occurs as soon as an item or skill that targets allies is selected in battle.
Same error, but with other plugins turned off:
If anyone knows how to fix these issues, please let me know.  Any help is appreciated.
The plugins mentioned can be found here:
Victor Engine Battle Status Window
Magnus0808's Single Actor System
Galv's Single Actor Menu Target

posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body:
Not sure that this is relevant (apologies if not) but when having a play with the Victor Battle Status Menu plugin today, I found out that you not only need his Basic Module plugin (as the help says), but, if you have any skills that target all enemies, you also need his Toggle Targets plugin. (If you don't want to toggle targets don't use its notetags for skills.)
I found this out by trawling through an old thread in MV plugins. If I hadn't have found it then I would have been stuck.
Edit
: I am trying to improve my battle status menu for a battle party of 6, so possibly coming from a different direction than you. I only tested spells that heal the whole party after I added the Toggle Targets plugin.
Later Edit
: Regarding your problem with your actor being highlighted, could it be anything to do with the "Active Select" parameter in the "Active Setup" section of the parameters? Have you tried setting "Active Select" to false?

Sorry for the late reply, but I looked through the plugin again and I found it was the "Active Select" parameter that was causing the highlight to remain; It went away after I set it to false.  Thanks for bringing that to my attention.
As for VE's other plugins, I had Basic Module already but not Toggle Targets.  I've heard about and experienced the game crashing with VE Battle Status Menu when selecting a multi-target skill in battle, but adding Toggle Targets does seem to fix the issue.  YEP's Battle Engine Core also seems to prevent the issue from occurring, as I've never experienced it while that plugin was turned on.
In regards to my second issue, one thing I forgot to mention is that when going to actor selection in battle after choosing a skill that targets allies (e.g. healing or support skills), the battle status window reverts back to the default list style.  This is another reason why I want to be able to skip actor selection in battle.

I haven't had a chance to down my first cup of coffee for the morning yet, so please don't be upset if I misunderstand you. I presume that you refer to the little menu that picks which ally to apply a skill that affects one ally? Apparently, it is a different menu, i.e. not part of the battle status menu, so Victor Sant's Battle Status Menu doesn't apply to it. When I found the original thread on "MV Plugins", someone had asked about him about this issue. He replied that it would need a new plugin that he might get round to at some point. (As far as I am aware, he never did.)
I can see the what you are talking about in the test project that I was playing with. Because I want a battle party of 6, want to see the gauges etc. of all the battle party at the same time and still have room to see the enemies, I reduced the font size of the battle party menu to 16. When someone casts a spell to heal an ally, the menu to choose which ally to heal is in the default, larger font.
The only suggestion that I have is that if your game has a party of 1 throughout,  changing healing spells to affect the user rather than an ally. Don't know whether this is applicable to your project, though.
Edit
: If you find a way to alter the menu that chooses which ally to apply a skill to, I would be very interested to hear about it.
Edit2
: I might take a look at his Battle Command Menu plugin, but I can't see me doing it this morning, and may not be able to do it for a few days. If I find out anything relevant I will either add it to this post, or, if someone replies to the thread before then, do a new post. [I don't think they like multiple posts from the same person with no intervening post from anyone else.]

posts.author: Tamarin
posts.body:
Yes, it's the menu for choosing an ally to use an item or skill on.  I tried changing the scope of several items and skills in the database to target the user instead of "1 ally."  Unfortunately, this does not cause actor selection to be skipped.
There was actually another solution I considered for the actor selection window.  I also have a plugin called
Super Tools Engine
, by SumRndmDde.  It's a playtest editor that allows you to edit windows in several ways.  I tried using this editor to hide the actor selection window so that my custom Victor Engine window remained visible.
However, this doesn't actually skip actor selection, and another downside is that the player no longer has anything to click on to confirm using the item or skill on an ally, although they can still press the enter key.

posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body:
Start of Edit1
: Thought that this edit should go at the front of this post.
The reason the Battle Actor Window appeared was because of one the Victor Sant plugins.
Just put the plugins back into operation in my small test project. As you described, the Battle Actor Window appeared when using either "Potion for Me" or casting "Heal Me", items or skills that have "The User" as the scope.
I switched off the 3 Victor Sant plugins (VE_BasicModule, VE_ToggleTargets and VE_BattleStatusWindow) and left the other plugins turned on. In battle, the Battle Actor Window did
not
appear when the item and skill with "The User" were used.
For information, the other plugins were CommunityBasic, Show_All_Icons, PG_BattleParty6, PD_AdjustCharaSprite. The PG_BattleParty6 is a one-liner changing the maximum battle party to 6, at the moment.
I have left my original post underneath this edit.
End of Edit1
Edit 2:
Have a feeling that instead of using VE_BattleStatusWindow for my main project, I will be looking in detail at Some Random Dude's SRD_BattleStatusCustomizer. Not noticed any bugs in the test project yet, and, although it looks a bit cramped with 6 actors in the battle party, it seems to give a reasonable interface for the player, even if it looks a little more jazzy than I would usually go for. I altered one parameter, but otherwise it runs straight out of the box.
http://sumrndm.site/battle-status-customizer/
The SRD_SupertoolsEngine that you are considering seems very good, but RPG Maker MV is designed for up to 4 battle party members, and I suspect catering for larger parties is harder than for parties of 1.
I don't usually go for skills and items that just target the user, but nonetheless, I am not keen on the Victor Engine bug. It makes me wonder whether there are other surprises in store for developers who use it. I am also not keen on having to use 3 plugins to do half a job. (SRD_BattleStatusCustomizer is in two parts, both of which you need, but it does do the Battle Actor Window at the same time.)
Good luck with whatever method you decide to use. If I find out anything else that I think is relevant to you, I will post it.
End of Edit 2
Start of original post
Must admit that I am puzzled that you are still seeing the menu to select the actor (I think it is called the "Battle Actor Window") when using skills or items that have "The User" as their scope. I have just turned off all plugins of the test project I have been using, created a "Heal Me" skill that applies to only the user and a "Potion for Me" that restores HP to the user. I ran a new game, and no menu to select the actor appeared when party members used either the "Heal Me" skill or the "Potion for Me" item in battle.
I also tried having a single actor in the party, with no plugins active, and also with a simple plugin to set the battle party to 1. In both these tests, the Battle Actor Window did not appear when the "Potion for Me" was used.
My test project is very recent; I only created it to look at the revised version of Mr. Trivel's Party Manager. My MV is version 1.6.1.
The only things that I can think of are either that another plugin may be affecting the battle behaviour, or, is it possible that you used a saved game from before you made changes? When I have used old saves after changing plugins, or changing default maximums in the database, I have had inexplicable things happen during play.
Spoiler:
Limited relevance if you are trying to supress the Battle Actor Window
Yesterday afternoon I happened to have a look at the "rpg_windows.js" core file. Unless I am even thicker than I believe, MV to creates the Battle Actor Window using the settings for the Battle Status Window. Unfortunately, Victor Sant's plugin doesn't get the Battle Actor Window to use the new settings from its parameters, so the Battle Actor Window looks like a version of the
default
Battle Status Window, but positioned a little to the left of the the BSW's actual position.

posts.author: Tamarin
posts.body:
It doesn't seem like there's a fix or workaround out there for the Victor Engine bug, so I looked into
SRD's Battle Status Customizer
.  After figuring out the parameters of this two-part plugin and using it alongside
Super Tools Engine
, this is what I managed to come up with for a new battle status window.
The Victor Engine issue is also not present here as skipping actor selection now seems to work as it should, so I'll be ditching that plugin in favor of the SRD plugins. Overall, while I still think my battle status window could be improved a bit further, I'm satisfied with what I have so far and it seems to work well without any major issues.

posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body:
Glad you found a solution that looks good and works.
I used SRD_BattleStatusCustomizer for my game with the battle party of 6 and got what I wanted, after a quick play with parameters. I then put it into the other game of mine that is supposed to be finished (which has the normal battle party of 4) with the default parameters, and it works a treat.
As I already use SRD_ActorSelect for various events, and SRD_MenuStatusCustomizer to get the main menu to show actor nicknames and ATT_Turan's approval ratings, I didn't even have to add a name to my credits.
